personas.name: F-E Developer
personas.reaction: A live netcode across browsers is the kind of change agents get subtly wrong: karts that freeze, a grid that never empties, and nothing in the first section says how any of it is tested without two people at two keyboards.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: No server and no host is the right call for a toy: each browser owns its kart and the database only checks who may join. I still read it as a gimmick until I race a colleague on it.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Racing the colleagues of my workspace live, with my best time putting me on pole: that is the delight that keeps a team coming back to the arcade.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: Browser Realtime is a new pattern in this app, and its quota is shared with the approvals stream. I want the budget written down and an ADR, not a guess in the frame loop.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: SINGLE stays exactly as players know it, so nobody loses anything; MULTI is the visible win players asked for.

objection.text: A live netcode written by agents is exactly where the bugs nobody can reproduce by hand are born: frozen karts, ghost grids that never empty. And if an arcade game saturates Realtime, the approvals stream, the heart of the product, goes down with it.

personas.name: B-E DEv
personas.reaction: The migration only adds policies, mirrors the check submit_score already makes, and has its own check file. The repository holds no rule, so I would review it.

personas.name: Paul - Product Manager
personas.reaction: Twenty-three criteria anyone can watch on two screens, SINGLE untouched and MULTI times on the same crew table: ready to build.

personas.name: Lead Engineer
personas.reaction: Four places and 80 messages a second as two constants, the quota risk named with its numbers, an ADR for the new pattern and a rollback that is a revert plus a drop: the cohesion I asked for.

personas.name: Irisa
personas.reaction: Scope held: no rooms, no CPU in MULTI, no change to SINGLE. A first live race players can try the day it ships.
